title: Aesthetic Judgements with Resultar
goal: Deliver considered aesthetic judgements in art criticism using resultar + adjective + de + infinitive, impersonal resultar, and indirect objects.
grammar: resultar + adjective + de + infinitive, impersonal resultar + adjective + infinitive, and indirect object + resultar

items: I can use resultar + adjective + de + infinitive and impersonal resultar + adjective + infinitive without adding an extra preposition.
I can attribute aesthetic impressions to a viewer with an indirect object + resultar + agreeing adjective.
I can use art-criticism vocabulary (el claroscuro, desconcertante, evocador, sobrio, audaz, descifrar) to evaluate an exhibition.
